description: Where a term is legally defined, in every act on the site: the term, its alias ("toliau – …"), the definition text, the act and article/part with a link, and the article's status today. Inflection-tolerant ("vartotojo objektas" = "vartotojo objektą"). The same word often means different things in different acts ("vartotojas" in EĮ, EEĮ, GDĮ, VTAĮ): all are returned, plus narrower terms ending in it ("elektros energijos vartotojas").

act.description: Optional: the meaning in this act (key, abbreviation, TAR code or name). If the act does not define the term itself but says its terms are understood as defined in other acts ("sąvokos suprantamos taip, kaip jos apibrėžtos … įstatyme"), those acts' definitions are returned, with the sentence in by_reference

term.description: A word or phrase: "vartotojo objektas", "bešeimininkis daiktas"

name: find_definition
